excerpt.zh:
我们被垃圾包围了。

时不时就有新裂缝在我们周围的太空中打开，并向旋转的垃圾堆中倾倒更多的垃圾。根据碎片的性质，我们判定这里是一个星际文明的垃圾场。未知机器的零件和碎片与外星家庭的日常一次性用品掺杂散落在一起。

一般来说，这些物品的价值与废料无异。然而，我们的传感器却在其中发现了生命的迹象。

一个穿着宇航服的未知生物的处于休眠状态。目前还不清楚它在这里漂浮了多久。

texts.zh:
我们被垃圾包围了。

时不时就有新裂缝在我们周围的太空中打开，并向旋转的垃圾堆中倾倒更多的垃圾。根据碎片的性质，我们判定这里是一个星际文明的垃圾场。未知机器的零件和碎片与外星家庭的日常一次性用品掺杂散落在一起。

一般来说，这些物品的价值与废料无异。然而，我们的传感器却在其中发现了生命的迹象。

一个穿着宇航服的未知生物的处于休眠状态。目前还不清楚它在这里漂浮了多久。
texts.en:
We are surrounded by garbage.

From time to time, we have witnessed new tears in space open around us and dump even more garbage into the swirling heap. Based on the nature of the debris, this space is being treated as a junkyard for a star-faring civilization. Parts and pieces of unknown machines are littered amongst the everyday disposables of alien households.

Generally, these items are of no greater value than scrap. However, our sensors have picked up signs of life.

Inside of a spacesuit, the unconscious body of an unknown organism lies dormant. It is unclear how long it has been floating here.

label.en: Bring it aboard and give aid.
Bring it aboard to recover its gear.

texts.zh:
把那个漂浮在垃圾堆里的外星人带回来是个错误的决定。

在恢复了他的核心体温，稳定了生命体征后，这个外星人很快就复苏了——他满脸困惑，神经紧绷。

他很快抓住了一位我们医疗团队的人员，用靴子中抽出的武器把他们劫为人质。他说着一种我们无法理解的语言，来来回回地指着球体的控制面板，反复强调着同一个短语。
texts.en:
Taking in the alien found floating within the garbage was a mistake.

After restoring its core temperature and tending to its vitals, the alien revived quickly - confused, and alarmed.

It quickly grabbed a member of our medical team and is currently holding them hostage with a weapon drawn from their boot.They speak a language we do not understand and routinely point to the Sphere's controls, emphatically repeating the same phrase.

texts.zh:
把那个漂浮在垃圾堆里的外星人带回来是个错误的决定。

是这件宇航服让这个外星人保持休眠的。一经脱下，这个生物很快就苏醒了——他满脸困惑，神经紧绷。

他很快抓住了一位我们医疗团队的人员，用靴子中抽出的武器把他们劫为人质。他说着一种我们无法理解的语言，来来回回地指着球体的控制面板，反复强调着同一个短语。
texts.en:
Taking in the alien found floating within the garbage was a mistake.

Its spacesuit kept the alien in hibernation. After removal, the creature revived quickly - confused, and alarmed.

It quickly grabbed a nearby welding torch and is currently holding a member of our engineering team hostage.They speak a language we do not understand and routinely point to the Sphere's controls, emphatically repeating the same phrase.

texts.zh:
总的来说，我们干掉了这个从垃圾堆里拖回来的好斗生物。

虽然人质受了一些轻微的烧伤，但我们保安人员的迅速行动避免了进一步的伤害。

我们也就有了充足的时间去分析他的装备中携带的文件。初步翻译表明，他的身份是一名资深垃圾搬运工。他应该是把自己不小心混进了垃圾堆里，再也回不了家了。

暂且不提那个生物，我们会留在裂隙里，确认并回收尽可能多有价值的废料才回去。
texts.en:
We have summarily dispatched the belligerent creature we've rescued from this trash dump.

Though the hostage sustained some minor burn injuries, the quick actions of our security officer prevented any further damage.

We have had time to analyze the documents it held in its gear. Early translations of its identifications indicate it was a veteran trash hauler. It must have accidentally dumped itself into this garbage heap along with its load, never to return home.

Ignoring the creature for now, we will be remaining the rift until we have finished identifying and recovering as much valuable scrap as possible.

texts.zh:
总的来说，我们干掉了这个从垃圾堆里拖回来的好斗生物。

因为他的装备已经被剥离，对我们来说用普通的等离子子弹来终结他就是小菜一碟。

我们也就有了充足的时间去分析他的装备中携带的文件。初步翻译表明，他的身份是一名资深垃圾搬运工。他应该是把自己不小心混进了垃圾堆里，再也回不了家了。

暂且不提那个生物，我们会留在裂隙里，确认并回收尽可能多有价值的废料才回去。

至于我们取回的他的服装具有高度先进的构造，我们打算留着进行进一步研究。
texts.en:
We have summarily dispatched the belligerent creature we've rescued from this trash dump.

Completely stripped of gear, it was no great difficulty for us to neutralize it with a simple plasma round.

We have had time to analyze the documents it held in its gear. Early translations of its identifications indicate it was a veteran trash hauler. It must have accidentally dumped itself into this garbage heap along with its load, never to return home.

Ignoring the creature for now, we will be remaining the rift until we have finished identifying and recovering as much valuable scrap as possible.

The suit we recovered is of a highly advanced construction which we plan on keeping for further study.

texts.zh:
为表善意，我们放下了手里的武器。作为回应，这位外星人也松开了我们的[Explorer.GetCrewMember]，并同样放下武器。他看起来情绪十分地激动复杂，不过在这种情况也是可以理解的。

给了他一点冷静的时间，他开始愿意与我们沟通了。

我们开始寻找一种适当的方式来进行对话。虽然进展缓慢，但从其掌握的文件的初步翻译来看，这个外星人已经有几百岁了。
texts.en:
Demonstrating our peaceful intentions, we laid down our weapons. The alien released its grip on our [Explorer.GetCrewMember] and dropped their weapon in return. It appears to be in a highly emotional state, as is to be expected under the current circumstances.

Given some time to calm down, it became receptive to our communications.

We have begun the process of finding a way to hold a proper conversation. Progress has been slow, but early translations of the documents found in its possession indicate the alien is hundreds of years old.

texts.zh:
这位外星人的名字叫[astral_rift_dimensional_dump_leader_loc.GetName]。

有一次在往这个次元倾倒垃圾的途中，[astral_rift_dimensional_dump_leader_loc.GetHeShe]无意间被卷入了事故。[astral_rift_dimensional_dump_leader_loc.GetHisHer]舰船的次元引擎发生了一些技术故障需要手动维修，而[astral_rift_dimensional_dump_leader_loc.GetHeShe]则是唯一一个具有维修技术的人。在维修的过程中，[astral_rift_dimensional_dump_leader_loc.GetHeShe]不小心滑入了时空压缩器中，然后失踪了。

[astral_rift_dimensional_dump_leader_loc.GetHisHer]先进的宇航服中的生命支持系统使[astral_rift_dimensional_dump_leader_loc.GetHimHer]保持昏迷超过两个世纪以上。

虽然[astral_rift_dimensional_dump_leader_loc.GetName]悲伤地思念着家人，但[astral_rift_dimensional_dump_leader_loc.GetHisHer]也知道我们没有办法把[astral_rift_dimensional_dump_leader_loc.GetHeShe]送回[astral_rift_dimensional_dump_leader_loc.GetHimHer]来的地方。

[astral_rift_dimensional_dump_leader_loc.GetHeShe]具有驾驶先进舰船的极高技艺，应该能很好地适应我们的舰队训练项目。
texts.en:
The alien's name is [astral_rift_dimensional_dump_leader_loc.GetName].

On a routine haul to dump a load of trash into this dimension, [astral_rift_dimensional_dump_leader_loc.GetHeShe] was inadvertently sent along for the ride. A technical issue with the dimensional drive aboard [astral_rift_dimensional_dump_leader_loc.GetHisHer] ship required manual repair, and [astral_rift_dimensional_dump_leader_loc.GetHeShe] was the only one with the technical skill to fix it. In doing so, [astral_rift_dimensional_dump_leader_loc.GetHeShe] accidentally slipped into the space-time compressor and was lost.

The life support systems of [astral_rift_dimensional_dump_leader_loc.GetHisHer] advanced spacesuit kept [astral_rift_dimensional_dump_leader_loc.GetHimHer] in hibernation for over two centuries.

[astral_rift_dimensional_dump_leader_loc.GetName] grievously miss[astral_rift_dimensional_dump_leader_loc.GetEsXX] [astral_rift_dimensional_dump_leader_loc.GetHisHer] family, but know[astral_rift_dimensional_dump_leader_loc.GetSXX] we have no means to return [astral_rift_dimensional_dump_leader_loc.GetHimHer] from whence [astral_rift_dimensional_dump_leader_loc.GetHeShe] came.

Having notable skills in piloting advanced craft, [astral_rift_dimensional_dump_leader_loc.GetHeShe] would fit nicely into our fleet training program.

label.zh: 技术高超的驾驶员永远不嫌多。
label.en: A skilled pilot is always a welcome addition.

texts.zh: 在经过严格的训练后，[From.GetName]不仅证明了自己是一位出色的飞行员，还取得了我们军官们的信任。[From.GetHeSheCap]可以成为一名出色的指挥官，现已入役等待指派。
texts.en: After extensive training, [From.GetName] [From.GetHasHave] proven to be an excellent pilot and [From.GetHasHave] earned the confidence of our officers. [From.GetHeSheCap] will make an excellent Commander and [From.GetHasHave] been promoted to active service, awaiting assignment.
